Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
KNURLED THUMB NUTS (FIXTURES) 

(Incorporating Amendment No. 1) 



I 



8 

H 



1. Scope — Dimensions and requirements for knurled thumb nuts for use in the assembly of 
clamping screws according to IS : 6398-1971 ^Specification for clamping screws (fixtures)'. 

2. Dimensions 

WtV) 




STRAIGHT KNURL 0*8 mm IS r 3403 







All dimensions in millimetres.

Note - Dimensional deviations for untoleranced dimensions: 

Medium class accordinj( to 18:21021969 'Allowable deviations for dimensiiins without specified 
tolerances ( jirnt rrviswn Y. 



3. Designation — Knurled thumb nut of size M8 shall be designated as: 

Knurled Thumb Nut M8 IS : 6335 

4. Mechanical Properties — Knurled thumb nuts conforming to this standard shall be 
manufactured from steel conforming to the property class 4 as specified in IS : 1367-1967 Technical 
supply conditions for threaded fasteners ( first revision Y. 

5. Grade — Precision grade (P) of IS : 1367-1967. 

6. Marking — To be marked at an appropriate place with the designation and the manufacturer's 
name and trade-mark. 

6.1 ISI Certification Marking ~~ Details available from the Indian Standards Institution, 
New Delhi 2. 

7. Preservation — Unless the purchaser has specified specific treatment at the time of making 
enquiry or at the time of placing the order, knurled thumb nuts shall be supplied in a well-cleaned 
condition and suitably protected against corrosion. 



Adopted 30 December 1971
